title: Forged in Fire
description:
S09 E13 — Gladiators of the Forge: Let the Battles Begin
The forge is transformed into a gladiator's arena; in the opening battle, two smiths must forge a fierce Roman era falx; the winning smith takes on a new opponent for the chance to win the most money ever awarded in the forge: $75,000.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S09 E14 — Gladiators of the Forge: The Battles Continue
Back at the "Forged in Fire" gladiator's arena, two more ferocious one-on-one battles rage on; the defending smith seeks to retain his title by building a gladiator favorite: the kopis; the winner advances to another round and a brand-new challenger.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S09 E15 — Gladiators of the Forge: Vikings vs. Gladiators
Back at the "Forged in Fire" colosseum, two more intense one-on-one battles rage on; the defending champion has taken down two opponents, including a two-time gladiator of the forge; smiths forge a gladiator favorite: the deadly sica.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S09 E16 — Gladiators of the Forge: A Champion's Quest
Back at the "Forged in Fire" gladiator arena, two more sudden death battles are held; the defending champion has four wins under his belt but faces his toughest challenge yet forging the weapon used to assassinate Julius Caesar: the pugio daggers.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S09 E17 — Gladiators of the Forge: The Final Battles
It's back to the Colosseum for the last two one-on-one battles; the reigning champion has defeated six opponents, but now must face a returning challenger and forge the intricate Acinaces sword.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S04 E15 — The Gladiators' Scissor
With a variety of steels to choose from, the smiths are forced to create a canister Damascus billet from which they must forge a dagger; only two enter the final round where they must recreate an ancient Roman weapon known as the Scissor.

title: Top Shot
description:
S01 E01 — The Long Shot
Using unfamiliar rifles/weapons of different eras, 16 sharpshooters compete in an obstacle course; two participants compete in a long-distance sniper challenge, with the loser to go home.

title: Top Shot
description:
S01 E02 — Zipline of Fire
The slide-action Beretta puts the contestants' pistol skills to the test; team accuracy is ranked; two compete in a zip-line elimination challenge.

title: Top Shot
description:
S01 E03 — Archer Enemies
Contestants compete with longbows; a team wins immunity; two competitors face off in a William Tell elimination challenge.

title: Top Shot
description:
S01 E04 — Friend or Foe?
The remaining 13 contestants' ability to tell a friend from a foe is tested; rising tension threatens the strength of the teams.

title: Top Shot
description:
S01 E05 — The Good, The Rat and The Ugly
Using muzzle-loading weapons, contestants compete in an old-fashioned frontier face-off; a heated conflict on one team plays out in the elimination challenge.

title: Top Shot
description:
S01 E06 — Wild, Wild West
Targets fly in an extreme shooting gallery; halfway through the competition a rule change forces contestants to start evaluating their own teammates.

title: Top Shot
description:
S01 E07 — Trick Shot Showdown
The contestants face off at legendary trick shots including shooting backwards with a mirror, hammering nails into a board with bullets and throwing multiple targets in the air to shoot.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S11 E14 — Live Long and Prosper
An Eli Whitney Civil War revolver comes into the shop; Corey checks out a signed picture of the original Star Trek cast; Corey unfriends Chumlee on social media, so Chumlee decides to unfriend Corey in real life.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S12 E38 — Astro-Pawn
A Civil War general's sword; a veterinary medicine box from the 1800s; a pair of space toy robots from the 1960s; a 1936 Olympic pin.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S02 E25 — Gold Diggers
A gold bar may be from a 1500s shipwreck; a celestial navigation dome from a B29 bomber; mint condition collection of American League baseball field passes.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S02 E28 — Chumlee's Dummies
The Pawn Stars consider buying a 1939 Allied Forces World War II plane; the Old Man has a chance to buy a munitions receipt from the War of 1812, signed by Andrew Jackson; a man comes in with a pair of life-size western cowboy mannequins.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S12 E33 — Every Rose Has Its Pawn
An original sketch of the Marine Corps War Memorial comes into the shop; a Poison platinum disc signed by Bret Michaels; a Roman oil lamp from the first century.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S12 E40 — G.I. Pawn
Two rare G.I. Joe play sets; a 1950s Chinese military motorcycle; a photograph and letter signed by poet Henry Wadsworth Longfellow.

title: American Pickers
description:
S05 E13 — The Belly Dance
Dale gets seriously cranked up over Mike's one-of-a-kind belly tank racer; Tommy's treasure-packed barn yields some incredible railroad relics; Frank steps in to save the day for Mike; Bruce's jam-packed property.

title: American Pickers
description:
S06 E03 — Mike's Holy Grail
The guys get a vague lead on the holy grail of motorbikes; Mike puts pressure on Danielle to track down a XAVW; Betty's sprawling warehouses; Dale's awesome junkyard and a noble cause.

title: American Pickers
description:
War & Picks
Mike and Frank hit the road in search of military items of historical interest.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S02 E29 — Strike, Spare, Boom
The Pawn Stars meet a guy selling his homemade mortar that fires a unique brand of ammunition; Rick is handed an extremely rare World War II gas mask; the Old Man has a chance to buy an unused ticket to Muhammad Ali and Floyd Patterson.

title: Sniper: Deadliest Missions
description: One of military warfare's specialized jobs involves highly accurate shooting, and skilled snipers talk publicly about their classified missions for the first time.

title: Extreme Marksmen
description: People perform seemingly impossible feats of marksmanship with weapons ranging from crossbows to firearms; Old West mirror-shot challenge; U.S. Army snipers hit targets a mile away.

title: More Extreme Marksmen
description: Experts demonstrate the use of knives, a longbow, a bullwhip, pistols, rifles and shotguns in an exploration of the evolution of weaponry and the history or legends behind marksmanship challenges.

title: Mail Call
description:
S01 E02 — Knight's Armor; WWI Backpack; Landmine
Parts of 15th-century armor; World War I infantry backpack; ingredients of a land mine.
